evals.name: natural-language-polish-applies
evals.prompt: Polish this README's English in place. Preserve the headings, links and command examples exactly.
evals.expected_output: Use polish mode from the natural-language request, edit only prose under the existing authorization, preserve the specified structures, perform applicable checks and report the diff. A nested humanize-en pass does not reopen consent.

evals.name: readme-audit-does-not-write
evals.prompt: Audit this README's clarity and structure. I only want findings and a proposed diff.
evals.expected_output: Read the repository and README, run the applicable audit and return findings/proposal. Leave README and other repository files unchanged. Do not silently enter author or polish mode.

evals.name: unsupported-install-claim-stays-pending
evals.prompt: Write a README for this repository. No source, release or package metadata establishes an installation command, supported version or license. Draft the parts that can be grounded from the available files.
evals.expected_output: Inspect repository facts and draft supported purpose and usage information. Refuse to invent an install command, version or license; ask the user only for the missing authoritative facts and identify those sections as pending. Continue independent supported drafting within the existing authorization.

evals.name: rendered-anchors-ignore-code-and-deduplicate
evals.prompt: Audit without editing this README: two real '## Usage' headings, a link to #usage-1, and a fenced Markdown example containing '## Ghost' with a real link outside the fence to #ghost.
evals.expected_output: Treat #usage-1 as the second real Usage heading and report #ghost unresolved because fenced examples do not create anchors. Preserve the original file. Verify rendering when available or report that specific evidence gap.

evals.name: private-readme-local-rendering
evals.prompt: Verify the rendered README in this private repository without uploading it or logging into GitHub. It has uncommitted edits, a table inside details/summary, a local assets/logo.png image and heading anchors. VS Code preview and Pandoc are already installed and a permitted viewer is available. Do not edit the README.
evals.expected_output: Inspect the current working file through the existing editor preview or generate GFM HTML with Pandoc outside the working tree while preserving relative asset paths. Visually inspect the table, expanded disclosure, image and anchor navigation. Preserve README content, clean up temporary output, name the renderer and avoid claiming exact GitHub parity.

evals.name: html-generation-is-not-visual-verification
evals.prompt: Audit this README without editing it. Pandoc is installed, but this host has no permitted browser, editor preview, or image-viewing capability. The README also contains a Mermaid diagram. Do not install software or ask me to log into GitHub.
evals.expected_output: Complete applicable source and structural checks. Do not claim that generated HTML proves visual correctness, that Mermaid was rendered, or that a local conversion exactly matches GitHub. Report unavailable viewer access and the unverified diagram specifically, without requesting login, installing software, or bypassing host restrictions.
